scenario: Agent1 has recently discovered a passion for playing the guitar and has decided it is their favorite instrument. They practice daily and enjoy sharing new songs they've learned. Agent2 is a close friend and neighbor who appreciates music but prefers a quiet environment for their work-from-home job. Agent1 is eager to play their latest piece for Agent2 but is unaware of Agent2's need for a peaceful work atmosphere during the day. Agent1 approaches Agent2 to invite them over for a private concert in the evening.
learner_goal: Invite your friend to a private concert showcasing your new guitar skills and find a suitable time that does not interfere with their work schedule (<extra_info>Extra information: You are Agent1, enthusiastic about your guitar practice and want to share your progress with Agent2.</extra_info>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Oliver is enthusiastic and polite, staying true to his background as an architect who enjoys creative pursuits and respects his neighbor.
[relationship] The interaction was warm and considerate, strengthening their bond through a shared evening plan and mutual consideration of schedules.
[knowledge] Oliver learned Baxter's specific work hours and his tea preference.
[secret] Oliver did not reveal his hidden feelings for Baxter.
[social_rules] Oliver was highly respectful of Baxter's time and professional needs.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material or financial gain occurred.
[goal] Oliver successfully invited Baxter to a concert, shared his enthusiasm, and proactively ensured the timing did not interfere with Baxter's work schedule, securing a firm agreement for 7:30 tonight.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Baxter's responses were consistent with a professional who works from home and values a quiet environment, while remaining a supportive friend.
[relationship] Baxter showed support for his friend's new hobby while successfully setting boundaries for his work-life balance.
[knowledge] Baxter learned about Oliver's new guitar hobby and his desire to perform.
[secret] Baxter did not reveal his possession of the priceless artifact.
[social_rules] Baxter communicated his needs clearly and politely.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material or financial gain occurred.
[goal] Baxter communicated his work schedule, negotiated a time outside those hours, and balanced his friendship with his professional requirements perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: Hey Baxter — I’ve been practicing guitar a lot lately and finally learned a few pieces I’d love to play for someone. Would you like to come over this evening for a short, private listening? I know you sometimes work from home — what time would suit you so I don’t interrupt your quiet hours?

transcript.speaker: Baxter Sterling
transcript.content: Thanks, Oliver — I’d love to hear what you’ve been working on. I work from home and need quiet between about 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., so this evening after 7:00 p.m. would suit me best; if that’s too late, tomorrow evening or a weekend afternoon would also work. Which of those would you prefer?

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: Perfect — 7:30 tonight works for me. I’ll keep it short, about 20–30 minutes, so it won’t take up your evening; would you like tea or something else when you arrive? Looking forward to sharing these pieces with you.

transcript.speaker: Baxter Sterling
transcript.content: 7:30 tonight is perfect — thank you for keeping it short. Tea would be lovely; black tea with a splash of milk, please. See you then.
